integrity: Proof is self-contained and covers all quantified integers. Independent direct enumeration through n=42 supports but does not establish the universal theorem. Scientific review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Indexed circular binary words of Hamming weight three, uniform minimum cyclic spacing h>=2, n>=3h, position checksum modulo n. Does not establish deletion/insertion correction or higher-weight/general-modulus analogues. Historical-priority uncertainty persists for older specialized cycle subset-sum counts.
title: Near-uniform cyclic moment classes for three separated markers
